bulkification.title: Avoid DML and SOQL Inside Loops
bulkification.description: Never place database queries (SOQL) or DML operations inside for/while loops. Always aggregate records into Lists/Maps and perform bulk operations outside loops.

crudFlsEnforcement.title: Enforce CRUD/FLS Permissions
crudFlsEnforcement.description: Ensure queries use 'WITH USER_MODE' or 'WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED' or 'Security.stripInaccessible()' before processing DML or reading sensitive fields.

sharingModel.title: Explicit Class Sharing Declaration
sharingModel.description: Every Apex class must explicitly declare 'with sharing', 'without sharing', or 'inherited sharing'. Defaulting to unspecified sharing creates security vulnerabilities.

soqlSelectivity.title: Selective SOQL Query Filters
soqlSelectivity.description: Filter SOQL queries using indexed fields (Id, Name, external IDs, lookup/master-detail fields) and avoid leading wildcards ('%text') or negative operators (!=, NOT LIKE) on large tables.

testCoverageAndQuality.title: Robust Unit Test Assertions & Bulk Tests
testCoverageAndQuality.description: Unit tests must use Test.startTest() / Test.stopTest(), verify positive, negative, and bulk (200 records) scenarios, avoid SeeAllData=true, and include System.assertEquals / System.Assert statements.

declarativeFirst.title: Declarative vs Programmatic Rule
declarativeFirst.description: Prefer Salesforce Flow for standard record orchestration, simple branching, and email alerts. Reserve Apex for complex transactional logic, high-volume processing, custom integrations, or fine-grained governor control.

owaspLlmRisks.name: Prompt Injection
owaspLlmRisks.mitigation: Sanitize user inputs, strip directive escape sequences, enforce strict schema contracts.

owaspLlmRisks.name: Insecure Output Handling
owaspLlmRisks.mitigation: Do not execute AI code directly in production. Require human-in-the-loop review and static linting.

owaspLlmRisks.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
owaspLlmRisks.mitigation: Strictly scrub PII, production tokens, API keys, and customer data before feeding into AI prompts.

owaspLlmRisks.name: Overreliance / Schema Hallucination
owaspLlmRisks.mitigation: Cross-reference generated object and field names against validated org metadata dictionary.
